tools.name: Audio Factory
tools.commercial_use_note: Every recording, model and library retains its own rights.
tools.privacy: Local validation surface.
tools.notes: Validates candidate packs; does not publish gameplay audio automatically.

tools.name: Vault WebAdmin
tools.commercial_use_note: Operational access depends on the server and commercial boundary.
tools.privacy: Authenticated local or managed administration surface.
tools.notes: Administration surface, not a content-generation or gameplay authority.

tools.name: uo-godot-cli
tools.commercial_use_note: Review repository licence and every tested asset separately.
tools.privacy: Loopback development control plane.
tools.notes: Development-only inspection and bounded mutation; never a release-build gameplay dependency.

tools.name: Kanboard
tools.commercial_use_note: MIT software; plug-ins and hosted providers may have separate terms.
tools.privacy: Self-hosting keeps project data under operator control; remote hosting changes the boundary.
tools.notes: Visible planning source of truth; prefer user API permissions over unrestricted application API.

tools.name: Botte Secrète
tools.commercial_use_note: Review repository licence and licences of delegated models and tools.
tools.privacy: Local-first control plane; optional backends can cross local boundaries.
tools.notes: Routes and validates work; does not mutate Kanboard by default.

tools.name: Twine
tools.commercial_use_note: Official site states created works can be used commercially; story formats may have separate licences.
tools.privacy: Desktop app is local; browser mode stores work in the browser.
tools.notes: Useful for branching dialogue and quest prototypes before conversion to versioned game JSON.

tools.name: QGIS
tools.commercial_use_note: GPL software; data-layer licences remain separate.
tools.privacy: Local desktop unless remote data services are added.
tools.notes: Recommended free path for precise layers, roads, regions, elevation and geodata preparation.

tools.name: Blender
tools.commercial_use_note: Official Blender artwork and output are free to use; add-ons and imported assets retain separate licences.
tools.privacy: Local by default; optional add-ons may use network services.
tools.notes: Default local modeling, conversion, UV, retopology, rigging, animation and VFX hub.

tools.name: Inkarnate
tools.commercial_use_note: Commercial use depends on the applicable subscription and content terms.
tools.privacy: Maps and uploaded assets are processed by a cloud service.
tools.notes: Accessible illustrated-map path; export remains a visual reference until structured conversion.

tools.name: World Machine
tools.commercial_use_note: Basic is noncommercial; paid editions grant commercial export under their terms.
tools.privacy: Local desktop tool.
tools.notes: Procedural terrain path; validate edition rights and convert outputs into the target terrain contract.

tools.name: Houdini
tools.commercial_use_note: Apprentice is noncommercial; Indie and commercial editions have revenue, file-format and pipeline restrictions.
tools.privacy: Local software with licence service requirements.
tools.notes: Professional procedural terrain, modeling and VFX route; edition compatibility must be preserved.

tools.name: Material Maker
tools.commercial_use_note: Software is open source; community materials have individual CC0, CC-BY or other licences.
tools.privacy: Local application; community library access uses the network.
tools.notes: Recommended free node-based PBR path with Godot export.

tools.name: Poly Haven
tools.commercial_use_note: Assets are published under CC0; source provenance should still be recorded.
tools.privacy: Downloads from public Web service; no project upload required.
tools.notes: Curated CC0 source for HDRIs, textures and models.

tools.name: Meshroom
tools.commercial_use_note: Software is open source; photographed subjects and source images require rights.
tools.privacy: Local reconstruction; no upload required.
tools.notes: Local photogrammetry route; full reconstruction benefits from supported NVIDIA CUDA hardware.

tools.name: Adobe Substance 3D
tools.commercial_use_note: Use depends on plan, included assets, fonts and applicable Adobe terms.
tools.privacy: Desktop authoring with account and optional cloud services.
tools.notes: Professional texturing and material suite; preserve source and asset licences.

tools.name: Autodesk Maya
tools.commercial_use_note: Commercial, Indie, education and Flex eligibility differ.
tools.privacy: Desktop application with Autodesk account and licence services.
tools.notes: Professional modeling, character, animation and VFX route.

tools.name: ZBrush
tools.commercial_use_note: Commercial use follows the applicable Maxon subscription and asset terms.
tools.privacy: Desktop application with account and licence services.
tools.notes: Professional sculpting path; retopology and game-ready conversion remain separate gates.

tools.name: MakeHuman
tools.commercial_use_note: Bundled assets and official exports have documented CC0 treatment; third-party assets keep their own licences.
tools.privacy: Local application.
tools.notes: Free humanoid base generation; convert, optimize and audit third-party content.

tools.name: VRoid Studio
tools.commercial_use_note: Commercial use is broadly permitted for default content without special clauses; presets and third-party items can add conditions.
tools.privacy: Local creation with optional VRoid Hub cloud upload.
tools.notes: Accessible stylized avatar route; VRM requires a reviewed Godot conversion path.

tools.name: Mixamo
tools.commercial_use_note: Official FAQ permits royalty-free personal and commercial projects; imported source rights remain the user's responsibility.
tools.privacy: Characters are uploaded to an Adobe Web service.
tools.notes: Free Adobe-ID auto-rig and animation path, currently limited to biped humanoids.

tools.name: Cascadeur
tools.commercial_use_note: Free plan is noncommercial and export-limited; paid plans govern commercial use and perpetual entitlement.
tools.privacy: Local desktop application with account/licence services.
tools.notes: AI-assisted posing and physics animation path with plan-dependent exports.

tools.name: MetaHuman
tools.commercial_use_note: Included under Unreal Engine licence terms; revenue and seat conditions apply.
tools.privacy: Desktop and Epic account/cloud services may be involved.
tools.notes: Professional digital-human path; verify current engine-independent export and AI restrictions.

tools.name: Character Creator
tools.commercial_use_note: Software licence, plug-ins, export licence and purchased content terms can differ.
tools.privacy: Desktop tool with account, stores and optional cloud AI services.
tools.notes: Professional character pipeline; audit each content pack and export licence.

tools.name: Audacity
tools.commercial_use_note: Software is open source; recordings and plug-ins retain their own rights.
tools.privacy: Local editing; optional online services change the boundary.
tools.notes: Recommended free waveform recording and editing path.

tools.name: LMMS
tools.commercial_use_note: Software is open source; samples, instruments and plug-ins retain separate rights.
tools.privacy: Local desktop tool.
tools.notes: Free music composition and synthesis route.

tools.name: REAPER
tools.commercial_use_note: Discounted and commercial licence eligibility depends on use and revenue.
tools.privacy: Local desktop tool; plug-ins can change the boundary.
tools.notes: Accessible professional DAW with evaluation and one-time licence model.

tools.name: FMOD
tools.commercial_use_note: Project registration and revenue/development-budget eligibility govern commercial use.
tools.privacy: Local authoring; account and licence services required.
tools.notes: Interactive game-audio middleware; Godot integration and licence are separate gates.

tools.name: Wwise
tools.commercial_use_note: Per-title, platform, budget, plug-in, DLC or royalty conditions may apply.
tools.privacy: Local authoring with account/licensing services.
tools.notes: Professional interactive-audio middleware; register and review each title licence.

tools.name: Krita
tools.commercial_use_note: Official licence page states artwork remains the creator's property.
tools.privacy: Local and no registration required for official builds.
tools.notes: Recommended free illustration, concept-art and texture-painting path.

tools.name: GIMP
tools.commercial_use_note: GPL software; imported images, fonts and plug-ins retain separate rights.
tools.privacy: Local desktop application.
tools.notes: Free image editing, texture cleanup and UI asset path.

tools.name: Inkscape
tools.commercial_use_note: GPL software; artwork and imported fonts/assets retain their own rights.
tools.privacy: Local desktop application.
tools.notes: Recommended free vector, icon and interface asset path.

tools.name: Penpot
tools.commercial_use_note: Open-source core; enterprise and hosted services have plan terms.
tools.privacy: Self-hosted or cloud; data boundary depends on deployment.
tools.notes: Open-source UI and design-system collaboration route.

tools.name: Figma
tools.commercial_use_note: Use and export depend on plan, community assets, fonts and service terms.
tools.privacy: Cloud-hosted design data and collaboration.
tools.notes: Popular cloud UI/design-system alternative with account and data-hosting considerations.

tools.name: ComfyUI
tools.commercial_use_note: Software licence does not grant rights to models, LoRAs, nodes, datasets or outputs.

tools.name: Adobe Firefly

tools.name: Meshy

tools.name: Kdenlive

tools.name: DaVinci Resolve
tools.commercial_use_note: Free and Studio editions differ; third-party media, effects and codecs retain separate rights.
